name: rclone-s3-management-ui
description: Dev-only frontend toolchain for the Rclone S3 Management UI. The runtime image is Node-free; Tailwind ships as a committed build artifact and htmx is vendored.

scripts.check:css: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i tailwind.input.css -o /tmp/gbo-css-check.css --minify && cmp -s /tmp/gbo-css-check.css app/static/vendor/tailwind.css && echo 'tailwind.css is up to date' || { echo 'ERROR: app/static/vendor/tailwind.css is STALE - run: npm run build:css'; exit 1; }
